name: Mixed Allied Health Centre (multidisciplinary)
tags: physio, pilates / EP, podiatry, psychology wing, OT / speech, dietetics, gym on shopfront, same design family as premium GP, Rev A
description:
Quality, contemporary multidisciplinary allied health centre in the same design family as the DR Fitout premium GP concept. Designed for an assumed c. 400 m² tenancy (c. 25 x 16 m, one glazed shopfront to the south, rear service access).

KEY DESIGN MOVES
- Active / quiet split: gym, Pilates / EP studio and physio sit on one side (east); the psychology wing sits on the other (west) behind an acoustic door.
- Gym on the shopfront as visible 'shop window' activity, with a 10 m gait track along the glazing [TBC].
- Shared concierge reception + retail display (orthotics), wide open waiting with clear 1800 mm corridors.
- Quiet wing: its own discreet waiting, hot-desk practitioner office and a discreet rear exit for psychology clients [TBC]; 1600 mm quiet-wing corridor behind an acoustic door, carpet tile and sound masking.
- Rear spine (1800 mm) to service access: staff room, laundry / cleaner, equipment store, change room / shower and second exit [TBC].
- Accessible WC with shower plus ambulant WC off the waiting area.
finishes: Warm timber, fluted joinery, soft layered light and subtle violet accents with clinical-grade surfaces (same family as the premium GP). Gym / rehab floor: commercial rubber or sports vinyl (8–10 mm [TBC]) on acoustic / impact underlay, 10 m gait track inlaid in a contrasting colour with 1 m markings. Curved concierge desk in fluted timber veneer with solid-surface top; retail display joinery; carpet tile and sound masking in the psychology wing; acoustic panels; planting.
